# Generated Files

The following are outputs and must not be maintained by direct editing:

- `browser_files/dist/bundle.dev.html`
- `browser_files/dist/bundle.test.html`
- `browser_files/dist/bundle.prod.html`
- Files under `results/`
- Generated build manifests copied into `browser_files/dist/`
- Production acceptance and reproducibility reports
- Exported diagnostic packages and protocol result files

Modify modular source and rebuild. The production bundle is included only so the starter can validate and launch the accepted baseline without an implicit rebuild.
